Name: La Plage
Description: Nestled along the pristine, palm-fringed sands of Ashwem Beach in Pernem, North Goa, La Plage is widely celebrated as one of the most stylish and iconic beachfront restaurants in the region. Blending chic French coastal aesthetics with Goa�s laid-back susegad spirit, the restaurant features soft white sand flooring, vibrant turquoise wooden furniture, flowing linen canopies, and unobstructed panoramic views of the Arabian Sea. The culinary philosophy centers on sophisticated, contemporary French cuisine infused with fresh local seafood and tropical flavors. Popular signature menu highlights include the seared tuna steak with wasabi mashed potatoes, gratinated mussels in garlic butter, chicken liver p�t� served with sweet onion jam, and tender beef carpaccio. For dessert, patrons rave about the legendary "Chocolate Thali"�a decadent platter featuring an array of bite-sized chocolate creations�as well as the delicate coffee panna cotta and classic cr�me br�l�e. Accompanied by a sophisticated bar menu serving craft cocktails, fine wines, and chilled Sangria, La Plage offers an unhurried, luxurious beachside dining experience. Whether enjoying a long lunch under coconut palms or sipping cocktails at sunset, La Plage remains a must-visit culinary destination in Pernem.

Name: Burger Factory
Description: Situated along Morjim Beach Road in Pernem, **Burger Factory** is a legendary culinary hotspot renowned for serving some of the finest gourmet burgers in Goa. Originally starting as a modest roadside joint, the Morjim outlet has expanded into a spacious, bohemian-chic seaside venue featuring artsy wooden interiors, rustic brick accents, ambient dim lighting, and direct access to the beach sand. The kitchen specializes in thick, juicy, hand-crafted patties made from high-quality beef, chicken, pork, and gourmet vegetarian ingredients, all tucked between soft, house-baked brioche buns. Popular crowd favorites include the Double Cheddar Beef Burger with Crispy Bacon and Barbecue Sauce, the Spinach and Mushroom Burger topped with Feta and Truffle Oil, and the spicy Pulled Pork Burger. Every burger is served alongside ultra-thin, crispy hand-cut potato chips or zucchini fries. The beverage menu features creative boozy milkshakes�such as the famous Boozy Banana Shake�as well as artisanal craft beers and tropical cocktails. With its chill music, friendly vibe, and front-row seats to the Morjim sunset, Burger Factory is an essential stop for casual food lovers.
Popular dishes: Avocado Bacon Burger, Blue Cheese Burger, Hand-cut Potato Chips, Milkshakes
Address: 800, Morjim Beach Road, Vithaldas Vaddo, Morjim, Goa 403512

Name: The Lazy Dog
Description: Perched quietly near the sands of Mandrem Beach in Pernem,  The Lazy Dog  is a relaxed, tropical resort and open-air restaurant housed around a beautifully redesigned, quadrangle-style old Portuguese manor with a central swimming pool. Embracing a barefoot, unhurried lifestyle, the venue offers a peaceful garden courtyard, comfortable lounger seating, and elevated deck views overlooking the surrounding palm groves and beach sand dunes. The multi-cuisine menu caters to diverse international tastes, featuring an array of global comfort foods, fresh seafood, Continental bites, and authentic Indian dishes. Guests can indulge in wood-fired pizzas, creamy pastas, fresh avocado salads, grilled kingfish, and traditional Goan prawn curries alongside light finger foods. The well-stocked cocktail bar serves refreshing tropical concoctions, chilled beers, and signature gin infusions during sunset happy hours. The venue is particularly loved by travelers seeking a calm escape from louder party strips, offering a welcoming space to swim, read, dine, or sip cocktails while taking in the ocean breeze.

Name: Mango Tree
Description: Located along the vibrant coastal belt near Vagator and Pernem, Mango Tree  is an iconic open-air casual restaurant and bar that has welcomed travelers, backpackers, and locals for decades. Built around a sprawling, shady mango tree that forms the natural centerpiece of its dining deck, the venue exudes a nostalgic, friendly, and laid-back Goan vibe. Operating from early morning until late into the night, Mango Tree is renowned for its extensive, multi-cuisine menu that accommodates every possible craving. Options range from hearty English breakfasts, fresh tropical juice blends, and Israeli falafel platters to authentic Goan fish curry thalis, North Indian tandoori kebabs, and sizzling Chinese stir-fries. The bar serves cold draught beers, classic cocktails, and spirits, making it a popular neighborhood watering hole for social catch-ups and watching live sports matches on broad screens. With its affordable pricing, generous portions, and welcoming hospitality, Mango Tree remains a quintessential fixture of North Goa's casual dining scene.

Amenities: Outdoor Seating, Bar, WiFi, UPI Payment, Takeaway

Name: Martin's Corner
Description: Located in the quiet village of Betalbatim in Salcete, South Goa, Martin's Corner is a legendary Goan restaurant that has grown from a humble village corner shop into an internationally acclaimed culinary landmark. Celebrated for attracting celebrities, sports stars, and food lovers from around the globe, this sprawling, bustling venue features open-air wooden dining pavilions decorated with traditional Goan motifs, warm lighting, and a lively, festive atmosphere. The kitchen specializes in authentic, home-style Goan Catholic and seafood delicacies prepared using time-honored family recipes and stone-ground masalas. Signature dishes include the spicy Pork Sorpotel, aromatic Chicken Xacuti, tender Prawn Balch�o, Crab Xec Xec in roasted coconut gravy, and butter-garlic tiger prawns. Guests can also choose fresh catches of the day�such as pomfret, red snapper, or lobster�from a live ice display to be cooked to their preference. Complemented by live acoustic music, friendly service, and a fully stocked bar serving classic cocktails, Martin's Corner delivers an unforgettable taste of Goan hospitality.

Amenities: Outdoor Seating, Bar, Live Music, AC, WiFi, Card Payment, UPI Payment

Name: The Fisherman's Wharf
Description: Set along the scenic, palm-fringed banks of the Sal River in Cavelossim, Salcete, The Fisherman's Wharf is an upscale, flagship riverside restaurant that seamlessly combines Goan culinary heritage with modern maritime charm. Designed like a traditional Goan fishing village with rustic wooden decks, thatched roofs, and open-air pavilions extending over the water, the restaurant offers picturesque views of passing fishing trawlers and river scenery. The menu celebrates the rich marine bounty of the Arabian Sea and river estuaries, featuring an extensive array of fresh seafood cooked in both traditional Goan styles and international preparations. Standout menu items include the Kingfish Rava Fry, Goan Prawn Curry with Ukda Rice, Stuffed Squids in Recheado Masala, and Lobster Thermidor. In addition to seafood, the kitchen serves North Indian tandoori delicacies, Pan-Asian stir-fries, and Continental classics. With live musical performances, a lively bar crafting signature cocktails, and a family-friendly ambiance, The Fisherman's Wharf is one of South Goa's premier dining destinations.
Popular dishes: Fish Curry Rice, King Prawns Recheado, Lobster Thermidor, Crab Xacuti
Address: Near Bryson Supermarket, Mobor, Cavelossim, Salcete, Goa 403731
Amenities: Outdoor Seating, Riverside Views, Bar, Live Music, AC, WiFi, Card Payment, UPI Payment

Name: Cavatina by Avinash Martins
Description: Tucked away in the peaceful coastal village of Benaulim in Salcete, Cavatina by Avinash Martins is an award-winning, chef-driven fine dining restaurant that has redefined modern Goan gastronomy. Spearheaded by acclaimed chef Avinash Martins, Cavatina takes diners on an innovative culinary journey that honors Goa's indigenous culinary traditions while applying contemporary global techniques. The restaurant's intimate indoor and semi-open dining space is decorated with vintage Goan artifacts, clay pots, ancient feni jars (garraf�es), and local artwork. The menu showcases reimagined Goan classics, elevating neglected local ingredients and recipes from Saraswat Brahmin, Goan Catholic, and indigenous tribal communities. Highlights include red amaranth spanakopita, prawn hooman with teffla foam, compressed local musk melon salads, and coconut jaggery cheesecake. Each dish is presented artfully as a story of regional heritage. Offering impeccably curated wine pairings and personalized service, Cavatina provides an extraordinary fine dining experience in South Goa.
Popular dishes: Goan Chorizo Cigars, Seafood Mousse, Steak on Stone, Sol Kadi Ceviche

Name: Zeebop by the Sea
Description: Located directly on the soft white sands of Utorda Beach in Salcete, Zeebop by the Sea is an acclaimed beachfront seafood restaurant that captures the quintessential romance of South Goa's coastline. Shaded by towering coconut palms and rustic thatched canopies, Zeebop features open-air wooden decking decorated with colorful paper lanterns, wooden benches, and candlelit tables set right on the sand. The restaurant is widely famous for its fresh seafood display, where diners can select their choice of fresh fish, crabs, calamari, or tiger prawns to be prepared by the kitchen. Key menu highlights include the spicy Prawn Recheado, Fish Caldin, Crab Butter Garlic, and crispy Surmai Rava Fry, accompanied by traditional Goan breads and rice. The bar serves ice-cold beers, tropical feni cocktails, and fine wines that pair wonderfully with the sea breeze. Whether visiting for a sunny beachfront lunch or a romantic dinner under the stars, Zeebop by the Sea delivers authentic flavors in a relaxed setting.
Popular dishes: Stuffed Crab, Fish Caldine, Butter Garlic Calamari, Grilled Kingfish
Address: Opp. Royal Orchid Hotel, Utorda Beach, Salcete, Goa 403713

Name: Joet's Bar and Restaurant
Description: Situated along the quiet, horseshoe-shaped bay of Bogmalo Beach in Mormugao, Joet's Bar and Restaurant is a beloved family-run seaside eatery offering front-row views of the Arabian Sea. Perched right on the beachhead, Joet's features a relaxed, open-air wooden terrace where guests can dine while listening to the soothing sound of breaking waves. The restaurant is celebrated for its warm hospitality and a comprehensive menu that highlights fresh local catches, Goan classics, and international comfort food. Popular dishes include the Goan Fish Curry Rice, Butter Garlic Calamari, Tandoori Kingfish, Prawn Biryani, and sizzlers. The well-stocked bar serves cold draught beers, signature tropical cocktails, and spirits, making it a favorite sunset watching spot for travelers, locals, and flight crews stopping over from the nearby airport. With its laid-back atmosphere, friendly staff, and consistent quality, Joet's offers an authentic taste of Mormugao's coastal dining culture.

Name: Sheela Bar and Restaurant
Description: Located along the waterfront in Vasco da Gama within the Mormugao taluka, Sheela Bar and Restaurant is a legendary, no-frills local institution famous for serving some of the freshest and most authentic seafood thalis in South Goa. Housed in a simple, traditional establishment overlooking the Zuari River estuary, Sheela's has built a fiercely loyal following among local residents, port workers, and visiting foodies seeking genuine Goan flavors. The star attraction is the traditional Goan Fish Thali, which comes loaded with a piping-hot bowl of aromatic coconut fish curry, local red rice (ukda), crispy semolina-crusted fried kingfish or pomfret, clam tisreo sukem, kismor (dried prawn salad), and a digestive shot of sol kadi. The kitchen also serves mouthwatering � la carte dishes like Beef Chilly Fry, Prawn Masala Fry, and Crab Xec Xec. Unpretentious, affordable, and rich in flavor, Sheela Bar and Restaurant provides an authentic, unvarnished look into Goa's daily food traditions.

Name: Palacio do Deao
Description: Located in the quiet hinterland town of Quepem, Palacio do Deao is not merely a restaurant, but a dining experience housed within a 210-plus-year-old historic manor built in 1780 by a Portuguese nobleman. Overlooking the Kushavati River, this heritage property features a blend of Hindu and Portuguese architecture surrounded by lush pleasure gardens. Dining here requires prior reservation, as hosts Ruben and Delia Vasco da Gama welcome guests as personal patrons into their restored estate. The fixed multi-course lunch is served on the airy patoi (veranda) overlooking the gardens. The menu showcases Goan-Portuguese cuisine prepared from family recipes, featuring dishes like pumpkin soup, fish croquettes, Prawn Balch�o, tender pork roast, and caldin curries, paired with homemade feni cocktails or wine. Dessert features traditional layered bebinca served alongside fresh seasonal fruits. Exploring the antique-filled rooms and manicured grounds before or after lunch completes a fine dining and heritage experience in Quepem.
Popular dishes: Prawn Rissois, Pork Balchao, Pumpkin Soup, Goan Fish Curry, Serradura

Name: Jila Bakers and Confectioners
Description: Tucked away in the village of Loutolim in Salcete, Jila Bakers and Confectioners is an artisanal bakery celebrated across Goa. Founded by the late Jose Ignacio Loudovico Antao (whose initials form "JILA") after training at Mumbai�s famous Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, this home-run bakery operates out of an ancestral Goan home. Jila is world-renowned for its legendary melting eclairs�choux pastry buns filled with rich, homemade chocolate cream and topped with chocolate glaze. Another signature specialty is their crisp, buttery geneva palmier cookies, alongside apple tarts, plum cakes, and melting melting-moment biscuits. Operating without flashy commercial branding, Jila relies on word-of-mouth reputation, attracting sweet lovers, food critics, and travelers from across the country. Buying freshly baked boxes directly from the Antao family parlor offers an authentic taste of Goan pastry-making heritage.

Name: Pedro's Beach Shack
Description: Situated along the sands of Benaulim Beach in Salcete, Pedro's Beach Shack is a long-standing coastal establishment that captures the classic, unhurried Goan beach shack culture. Constructed with a wooden frame, thatched palm fronds, and open-air decking, Pedro's provides guests with a comfortable spot to spend the day relaxing on sun beds right by the water. The kitchen serves a multi-cuisine menu highlighting fresh seafood caught daily by local Benaulim fishermen. Guests can select kingfish, pomfret, tiger prawns, and calamari from an ice display, choosing to have them cooked in traditional Goan recheado masala, rava-crusted and fried, or grilled with butter garlic. In addition to seafood, the menu includes continental breakfasts, North Indian curries, and tandoori snacks. Paired with cold beers, tropical cocktails, and views of the Arabian Sea, Pedro's offers a relaxed seaside dining option in South Goa.

Name: Pedro Longuinhos
Description: Located inside the historic Longuinhos Beach Resort along Colva Beach in Salcete, Pedro Longuinhos is a coastal restaurant that has welcomed travelers and local families for decades. Positioned steps from the sand dunes, the open-air dining space offers views of the ocean and palm groves. The restaurant's extensive menu features traditional Goan classics, global multi-cuisine options, and seafood specialties. Signature dishes include Goan Fish Curry Rice, Prawn Caldin, Pork Vindaloo, and tandoori seafood platters. The bar serves cold draught beers, local feni cocktails, and wines. With its family-friendly atmosphere, polite service, and proximity to Colva's shoreline, Pedro Longuinhos remains a reliable choice for seaside dining in South Goa.

Name: Sublime
Description: Known for its creative approach to fusion dining, Sublime is a fine dining venue created by Chef Chris Saleem that has held a prominent place in Goa's restaurant landscape. Famous for blending international gourmet culinary techniques with regional Goan, Indian, and Asian flavors, Sublime serves artfully presented dishes. Signature highlights include tuna bhel with tropical fruit salsa, sous-vide pork belly with honey-mustard glaze, and sea bass cooked with lemongrass and local spices. The dessert menu features homemade sorbets and chocolate creations. Paired with a curated selection of wines and craft cocktails, Sublime delivers a refined fine dining experience.

Name: Fernando's Nostalgia
Description: Situated in the village of Raia in Salcete, Fernando's Nostalgia is a boutique Goan restaurant dedicated to preserving traditional Goan-Portuguese home cooking. Founded by the late Chef Fernando Reis and now managed by his family, the restaurant operates in a leafy garden courtyard filled with Goan artifacts, ancient feni jars (garraf�es), and vintage collectibles. The menu highlights classic household recipes that are increasingly rare on commercial menus. Specialties include Feijoad (pork and bean stew), Pork Solantulem, Bacalhau (imported salted cod preparations), Prawn Hooman, and Caldeirada (Portuguese fish stew). Desserts feature traditional bebinca, alua, and alle belle (coconut crepe rolls). Accompanied by live acoustic Konkani and Portuguese music on weekends, Fernando's Nostalgia offers a cultural and culinary journey through Goan heritage.

Name: Elevar

Designed with open-sided wooden decks, chic white furnishings, and ambient warm lighting, the restaurant provides a sophisticated setting for long lunches or sunset dinners. The culinary concept focuses on contemporary European and Mediterranean cuisine integrated with fresh local seafood. Menu highlights include seared yellowfin tuna, crab cakes, butter-poached tiger prawns, hand-rolled pastas, and gourmet steaks. The bar serves creative mixology cocktails, gin infusions, and international wines. Elevar offers a refined, tranquil beachside dining experience in Pernem.

Name: Anantashram
Description: Located in the heart of Vasco da Gama within the Mormugao taluka, Anantashram is a historic, no-frills Goan seafood institution that has served local residents, port officials, and travelers since the mid-20th century. Renowned for its commitment to authentic, unvarnished Goan Hindu seafood preparation, the restaurant's star attraction is its traditional Goan Fish Thali. Served with local red rice (ukda), a bowl of coconut fish curry, kismor (dried prawn salad), clam tisreo sukem, and a shot of sol kadi, it is accompanied by crispy rava-fried kingfish, pomfret, or chonak. Name: Fisherman's Cove

Name: Bora Bora

Featuring wooden decking extending toward the sand dunes, comfortable daybeds, and ambient neon lighting, the venue caters to night owls, sunset watchers, and beachgoers. The multi-cuisine menu offers a wide variety of global comfort foods, including wood-fired pizzas, sushi rolls, burgers, pasta, Indian curries, and fresh Goan seafood. The central bar crafts signature cocktails, frozen margaritas, and pitch-perfect hookahs. With resident DJs playing deep house and chill-out tunes as night sets in, Bora Bora offers an energetic seaside dining and nightlife option in Morjim.

Name: Sousa Lobo (Benaulim Branch)
Description: Carrying forward the culinary legacy of the iconic Calangute institution, the Benaulim branch of Sousa Lobo brings classic Goan seafood traditions to the quieter shores of Salcete. Positioned near the beachhead, the restaurant features open-air dining decks, wooden furnishings, and views of the Arabian Sea. The kitchen specializes in authentic, traditional Goan recipes that have satisfied generations of diners. Signature specialties include the legendary Sousa Lobo Fish Curry Rice, Prawns Stuffed with Recheado Masala, Baked Crab in Shell, Pork Vindaloo, and Sausage Pulao. Name: Goodfellas
Description: Tucked away in Benaulim, Salcete, Goodfellas is an authentic Italian pizzeria and trattoria run by Italian expats passionate about traditional culinary arts. Set in a leafy garden courtyard of a Goan home, the restaurant offers an intimate, candlelit atmosphere suited for romantic dinners and relaxed group gatherings. The highlight of the menu is their authentic wood-fired, Neapolitan-style pizza, made with thin, slow-fermented crusts, San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and imported Italian toppings. In addition to pizzas, Goodfellas serves hand-rolled fresh pastas, antipasti platters, caprese salads, and homemade desserts like tiramisu and panna cotta. Accompanied by a selection of fine Italian and international wines, it is considered one of South Goa's best Italian dining spots.

Executive chefs craft an elegant menu featuring hand-rolled pasta, risotto, wood-fired pizzas, pan-seared sea bass, and tender lamb chops. Housed in a spacious venue designed with nautical themes, open-air wooden pavilions, and landscaped greenery, the restaurant delivers consistent quality and a lively ambiance.
